content.short: Timeless X is a non-custodial wallet powered by account abstraction, open social graphs, and censorship-resistant communication.
content.description: Timeless X is a non-custodial wallet built on account abstraction, open social graphs, and censorship-resistant communication to keep your activity and assets under your control. It supports major networks such as Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Linea, zkSync, Avalanche, and BSC, with onboarding options for all EVM-compatible networks. Integrated with Farcaster, Lens, and Telegram, it enables paying, connecting, chatting, and collaborating with others. A practical Web3 wallet for everyday use.
